<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914779_theRebbe_200" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914779_theRebbe_200__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The novelty that many waters cannot extinguish love is explained by their root in the state of tohu that preceded tikkun, yet the soul's love originates in the essential Ein Sof beyond even tohu.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the innovation in this—that many waters cannot extinguish the love—</t>
    <t s="2">is that it is known that the root of the many waters</t>
    <t s="3">[which are the distractions of livelihood]</t>
    <t s="4">is in the aspect of tohu that preceded tikkun.</t>
    <t s="5">For this is what is called "many waters," because they are "many"</t>
    <t s="6">(also)</t>
    <t s="7">from the perspective of their root and source.</t>
    <t s="8">And this is the superiority</t>
    <t s="9">in that many waters cannot extinguish the love, and rivers cannot wash it away—</t>
    <t s="10">for even though the root of the many waters and rivers</t>
    <t s="11">is in the aspect of tohu that preceded tikkun</t>
    <t s="12">(the root of the Nefesh HaElokis),</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless, they cannot, G‑d forbid, extinguish the love that is in the Nefesh HaElokis.</t>
    <t s="14">And the reason for this is</t>
    <t s="15">(as was stated previously)</t>
    <t s="16">"Its sparks are sparks of fire, a flame of Y-ah,"</t>
    <t s="17">that the root of the soul and the hidden love within it is in the Atzmus of Ein Sof, which is above even the aspect of tohu.</t>
    <t s="18">For the root of the love in the Nefesh HaElokis is in the aspect of a flame of Y-ah, as it is connected and hidden within the coal</t>
    <t s="19">(sparks of fire),</t>
    <t s="20">and higher still</t>
    <t s="21">—as it is in the aspect of Tzur</t>
    <t s="22">(which is above Havayah),</t>
    <t s="23">for there is the root of the soul,</t>
    <t s="24">as explained in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="25">in the interpretation of the verse,</t>
    <t s="26">"And the spirit shall return to the Elokim who gave it,"</t>
    <t s="27">that the aspect of Elokim</t>
    <t s="28">("who gave it")</t>
    <t s="29">is the aspect of the aforementioned Tzur.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Not only can the many waters not extinguish the soul's love, but through them the soul achieves an elevation through teshuvah, reaching a level higher than its original state before descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, not only do the aforementioned many waters lack the ability to extinguish, G‑d forbid, the love of the soul,</t>
    <t s="2">but moreover,</t>
    <t s="3">through them an advantage is produced in the love.</t>
    <t s="4">And this is that through the soul's descent below into this world and its enrobement in the aforementioned many waters, it reaches a more elevated level than its level before its descent below.</t>
    <t s="5">[And this is the ultimate intention of the aforementioned many waters.</t>
    <t s="6">Therefore, ultimately they lack the ability to extinguish the love,</t>
    <t s="7">because</t>
    <t s="8">the ultimate depth of the intention of the many waters themselves is, on the contrary, to effect an advantage in the love.]</t>
    <t s="9">And in avodah, the elevation that is produced in the soul through its descent below and its enrobement in the aforementioned many waters is that it comes to the matter of teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="10">And as is known,</t>
    <t s="11">that souls before their descent into a body are in the aspect of complete tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="12">and the advantage produced in them through their descent into a body is that they become in the aspect of baalei teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="13">for "in the place where baalei teshuvah stand, complete tzaddikim cannot stand,"</t>
    <t s="14">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="15">they cannot stand there,</t>
    <t s="16">for this is not</t>
    <t s="17">(even)</t>
    <t s="18">within the ability</t>
    <t s="19">of them.</t>
    <t s="20">And this is the reason the soul descended below,</t>
    <t s="21">for the matter of teshuvah</t>
    <t s="22">[although it is not specifically about transgressions,</t>
    <t s="23">but rather the return of the soul to its source and root]</t>
    <t s="24">applies specifically when it is not in its true place</t>
    <t s="25">(its source and root),</t>
    <t s="26">for then it is possible for it to return to its source and root,</t>
    <t s="27">the aspect of "And the spirit shall return to the Elokim who gave it."</t>
    <t s="28">And since the level of the baal teshuvah is more elevated than the level of tzaddikim</t>
    <t s="29">[to the extent that the difference between them is incomparable,</t>
    <t s="30">therefore, in the place where baalei teshuvah stand, complete tzaddikim cannot stand,</t>
    <t s="31">as above],</t>
    <t s="32">therefore,</t>
    <t s="33">through the matter of teshuvah that is renewed in the soul in its descent below, it is elevated even more than it was in its source,</t>
    <t s="34">in the aspect of "the Elokim who gave it."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Although the soul's root is in G‑d's essential self above all revelations, through teshuvah in descent it achieves an actualized elevation beyond its potential root, as understood from the analogy of Israel arising in thought.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And even though the root of souls is in His essential self, above all revelations,</t>
    <t s="2">as is proven</t>
    <t s="3">(also)</t>
    <t s="4">from what our sages said,</t>
    <t s="5">"In whom did He consult? In the souls of the tzaddikim,"</t>
    <t s="6">for the matter of consultation is also regarding the most elevated revelations</t>
    <t s="7">(since they are by will and not by necessity, G‑d forbid),</t>
    <t s="8">thus it is understood that the souls in whom He consulted are above all revelations,</t>
    <t s="9">nevertheless, it is possible to say that through teshuvah</t>
    <t s="10">(in their descent below)</t>
    <t s="11">an elevation is produced in them relative even to the level that was in their root.</t>
    <t s="12">And this will be understood based on what the Maggid said</t>
    <t s="13">in explanation of our sages' statement,</t>
    <t s="14">"Israel arose in thought,"</t>
    <t s="15">which is like a parable of a person who has a son,</t>
    <t s="16">for even when the son passed from before his face and went away from him,</t>
    <t s="17">nevertheless, the form of the son is engraved in the thought of the father.</t>
    <t s="18">However, among human beings this applies specifically to one who has a son, etc.</t>
    <t s="19">But regarding the Holy One, blessed be He, it is possible to say that even before Israel were created, their form was engraved in thought,</t>
    <t s="20">as our sages said,</t>
    <t s="21">"Israel arose in thought,"</t>
    <t s="22">for with Him, past and future are one.</t>
    <t s="23">And it is understood from this,</t>
    <t s="24">that this—that souls are rooted in His essential self and in them He consulted, etc.—is the matter of souls as they are in the aspect of created beings</t>
    <t s="25">(and as they descend below),</t>
    <t s="26">and only that</t>
    <t s="27">(also)</t>
    <t s="28">this form is engraved in His thought,</t>
    <t s="29">because with Him, past and future are one.</t>
    <t s="30">And as is known</t>
    <t s="31">in the explanation of "In whom did He consult," etc.,</t>
    <t s="32">that this is what arose before Him—the delight that He would delight, as it were, in the avodah of the souls below.</t>
    <t s="33">And based on this, the matter of the elevation produced in the souls through their descent below will be understood,</t>
    <t s="34">even though before their descent they are rooted in His essential self,</t>
    <t s="35">for this—that they are rooted in His essential self</t>
    <t s="36">(and in them He consulted, etc.)</t>
    <t s="37">—is from the perspective of His knowledge that afterward there will be their descent below, etc., and they will complete the intention.</t>
    <t s="38">And even though initially He knows with absolute certainty that they will complete the intention,</t>
    <t s="39">nevertheless, this is in potential,</t>
    <t s="40">and the ultimate elevation</t>
    <t s="41">(and intention)</t>
    <t s="42">is</t>
    <t s="43">the actual.</t>
    <t s="44">[And this is also the precise language of "In whom did He consult? In the souls of the tzaddikim,"</t>
    <t s="45">that when they are in the aspect of consultation</t>
    <t s="46">[for then their elevation is in potential,</t>
    <t s="47">for He knows they will complete the intention]</t>
    <t s="48">they are in the aspect of tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="49">and after their descent below</t>
    <t s="50">[for then they complete the intention in actuality]</t>
    <t s="51">they become in the aspect of baalei teshuvah].</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
